title: Pragmatic Curiosity: A Hybrid Learning-Optimization Paradigm via Active Inference
findings: This paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith. The use of a large language model (GPT-3.5 Turbo) was limited to a non-religious, technical task of evaluating object detection failures in an autonomous driving simulator based on predefined criteria like 'bad light' or 'large distance'.
